visual_review.review_method: Viewed the approved project Little John design before generation and opened the saved selected PNG with view_image after generation. No image alterations or crop previews.
visual_review.selection: generated-01.png retained as source candidate; not accepted for runtime
visual_review.identity: Broad mature face, long center-parted wavy brown hair, full long beard/moustache, bare head, hood-down green mantle, laced brown tunic, diagonal leather strap and brass clasp/buckle remain recognizable. The rendered portrait is not a pixel-identical enlargement of the reference.
visual_review.composition: One head-and-shoulders bust; both eyes open, clear and horizontally centered. Whole scalp/hair silhouette and full beard tip visible. Opaque plain charcoal background, no lettering or UI.
visual_review.craftsmanship_palette: Carved miniature-like beard/hair planes, coarse woven brown cloth, green wool and restrained brass hardware follow the project design. Hex colors were prompt targets, not colorimetric compliance results.
limitations: Top empty margin approximately 9% rather than requested 17%; head and hair are still completely visible.
Eye line sits near the upper quarter of the square, not its vertical center.
Broad shoulders and lower chest continue into the side and bottom edges; the full bust silhouette is not isolated.

A hypothetical centered circle of diameter 0.90 times the image width appears to retain head, hair and beard, but removes outer/lower shoulders and can reduce the strap buckle. This is a visual estimate, not a rendered circular-mask test.
A tighter eye-centered crop can lose hair or beard; detailed strands, lacing and textile texture may disappear at small sizes.
No actual circular crop, crop-coordinate acceptance, 32/40/64-pixel readability test, atlas conversion, runtime import or engine acceptance was performed.
visual_review.correction_decision: No actual head/hair clipping or material identity failure observed; no correction call authorized by the limited correction rule was needed.
